verifiedFacts.materials: The official homepage says its garments are 100% cotton.

designConcept: Independent product experience focused on turning a custom garment idea into a quote-ready request. Warm technical-green paper, deep ink typography, fluorescent citron for interactive moments, and garment shapes as simple illustrations rather than stock people. A single page narrative moves from product choice to structured brief.

decisionLedger.reason: The custom garment offer differentiates the shop from ordinary product discovery.

decisionLedger.decision: Collect garment, marking method, quantity and brief before contact
decisionLedger.reason: These fields are necessary to start a relevant quotation; no unsupported price estimate is shown.

decisionLedger.decision: Use no human photos; use simple garment silhouettes plus one official product image
decisionLedger.source: Business context and official product page
decisionLedger.reason: Keeps the preview product-led without inventing campaign photography.

decisionLedger.decision: Label bot as a rules-based prototype
decisionLedger.reason: No connected AI, product catalog API or business systems are available.

prototypeFunctions: Product cards prefill the customization request form.
Form validates quantity, composes a WhatsApp draft addressed to Tumua's publicly listed wholesale number, and requires the visitor to confirm sending in WhatsApp.
Assistant demo answers a limited set of product and customization questions using deterministic rules.
Responsive layout with a compact navigation toggle on mobile.
limitations: Not Tumua's official site and not affiliated with Tumua.
No live stock, size, price or custom quote lookup.
The chatbot is deterministic; it is not generative AI and is not connected to WhatsApp.
The WhatsApp draft is not sent by the prototype; the visitor must review and send it.
The example official product image may represent a sold-out listing; the page identifies it as a catalog reference, not a current offer.
